Sandbox_BeltRadio_MPBubble_tooltip: Multiplayer: a line received by a walkie-talkie hooked on the belt is also shown in a radio bubble above the player, as for a walkie-talkie in hand. Off: the line only appears in the radio chat (vanilla).
Sandbox_BeltRadio_BeltBattery_tooltip: A switched-on walkie-talkie hooked on the belt uses its battery every minute, as in hand. Off: the charge stays frozen at the belt and the drain is caught up when the walkie-talkie is taken in hand again (vanilla).
Sandbox_BeltRadio_BeltListening_tooltip: Singleplayer: a switched-on walkie-talkie hooked on the belt hears the station it is tuned to. Off: only a walkie-talkie in hand or a radio on the back hears anything (vanilla). A radio stored in the inventory never hears anything in singleplayer.
